posts.text:
The NBA just had its most-watched first month ever.

Per the league (Nov. 23), through month one of 2026-27 in the U.S.:
• 75M+ viewers, up 20% year over year
• Games averaging 2.62M viewers, a record at this point of a season
• Adults 18-34 viewership up 50%

Caveat: Nielsen measurement changes have tended to favor live sports.

Evidence-first NBA: https://www.mosport.app/?utm_source=threads&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=trend_radar_v1&utm_content=nba-viewership-month-one
